title: The week's measurement: PR CI median, catch-up merges, deploy provenance, master red time and reverts

story.i_want_to: read one report over a week that gives the PR CI median, the catch-up merges made without a conflict, whether every deploy came from verified/master, master's red time and the revert count
story.so_that: #985 closes on numbers, and a metric that did not move is named with its cause

rationale: #985's Done-when is four measured facts over a week, and nothing computes them: chg's S9 measurement script (chg/docs/design.md:424-427) is not in claude-config's bin/ or chg/bin/ (ls, 2026-11-20). The repo already has the shape for this: an offline mix task over JSON that gh fetched outside it, writing an artifact and a summary under docs/measurements (lib/mix/tasks/loopctl.gates.measure_a.ex:3-38). Merging the base only on a conflict is a standing rule (CLAUDE.md:491-530), and this report is what shows whether sessions follow it.

acceptance_criteria.description: Loopctl.ChgFlow.Report.pr_ci_median/2 returns the median wall-clock seconds (updated_at minus run_started_at) of the completed CI push runs at the head sha of each PR merged inside the window, ignoring master runs and runs outside the window.

Report.catch_up_merges/2 returns the PR commits inside the window that have two parents, whose second parent is a master commit, and whose recorded merge-tree result is clean; a merge whose merge-tree result is a conflict is not counted.

Report.deploys_not_from_verified/2 returns every production deployment inside the window whose sha has no successful Verify master advance run, and every Fly release inside the window whose image label is not verified-<sha>.

Report.master_red_seconds/2 sums, over CI push runs on master ordered by completion, each interval from a failed run that follows a green one to the next successful run, clipped to the window; an interval still open at the window's end ends there and is flagged open.
Report.revert_count/2 counts PRs labelled auto-revert that merged inside the window, and lists each with its culprit's PR from the body chg wrote.

`mix loopctl.chg_flow.report --inputs DIR --since ISO --until ISO --out F.json --summary F.md` writes the JSON artifact and a markdown table of metric, value, target and met, reading only files in DIR and making no network call.
A missing or unparsable input file stops the task with `missing input <name>: run scripts/chg/flow-inputs.sh <since> <until> <dir> first` and exit 1, never a partial report.

scripts/chg/flow-inputs.sh <since> <until> <dir> writes runs.json, prs.json, pr_commits.json (each two-parent commit with its `git merge-tree --write-tree` exit status), deployments.json, verify_runs.json and fly_releases.json, each gh or flyctl call under timeout 60.

test_cases.name: pr_ci_median over a window: master and out-of-window runs ignored
preconditions: test/loopctl/chg_flow/report_test.exs, async: true; build(:...) not needed: plain maps shaped like gh run list --json output, with three merged PRs (runs of 240, 300 and 720 s), one master run and one run before the window

test_cases.name: catch_up_merges counts clean merges of master only
preconditions: pr_commits with a clean merge of a master commit, a conflicted one, a merge of another branch and a one-parent commit

test_cases.name: deploys_not_from_verified flags an unverified deployment and a hand-labelled release
preconditions: deployments for shas A (with a successful advance) and B (without); fly releases labelled verified-A and deployment-20261201
expected_results: B's deployment and the deployment-20261201 release, nothing for A

test_cases.name: master_red_seconds sums red intervals and clips an open one
preconditions: master runs: green t0, red t1, red t2, green t3, red t4 with the window ending at t5

test_cases.name: revert_count counts merged auto-revert PRs only
preconditions: prs: one merged auto-revert PR whose body carries chg's culprit marker, one closed unmerged auto-revert PR, one merged ordinary PR

test_cases.name: the task writes both artifacts offline, and refuses a missing input
preconditions: @tag :tmp_dir holding the six input files from the unit fixtures
expected_results: both files exist; the markdown has one row per metric with its target and met column
the second run raises Mix.Error with the exact missing-input message and writes nothing

test_cases.name: flow-inputs.sh writes six files and records merge-tree status (stub gh, flyctl, git)
preconditions: @tag :tmp_dir; stub gh and flyctl answering fixed JSON; a repo with one clean and one conflicting merge of master
expected_results: six files present; pr_commits.json carries merge_tree_status 0 for the clean merge and 1 for the conflict; every stub call ran under timeout 60

technical_notes: Shape copied from Mix.Tasks.Loopctl.Gates.MeasureA (lib/mix/tasks/loopctl.gates.measure_a.ex:3-38): the network step (gh, flyctl, git fetch of refs/pull/<n>/head) is outside the task, so a run is offline and repeatable; artifacts go to docs/measurements/ beside gate_a_2026-10-19.{json,md}.

Loopctl.ChgFlow.Report is pure: every function takes the parsed inputs and the window, so the clock is an input (CLAUDE.md, Dependency Injection). The task only reads files, calls it and writes two files.

Names the inputs read: the CI workflow is `CI` (.github/workflows/ci.yml:1), the verifier `Verify master` with job advance (US-53.1), deploys are GitHub deployments in environment production (US-53.2, AC-53.2.6) and Fly releases with image label verified-<sha> (US-53.2). flyctl's releases JSON (fields carrying the image ref) is UNGROUNDED: confirm the field with a live `flyctl releases -a loopctl --json` before parsing.
Catch-up merges are read from PR commits (gh api repos/:repo/pulls/:n/commits), because PRs squash-merge (CLAUDE.md:531-532) and master's history never holds the branch's merge commits.
PR CI is the CI workflow's push run at the PR's head sha: workflows trigger on push only (ci.yml:4-12), so a PR's checks are its head's push run.

The week: it starts the day the fast commit hook merges (README build order), not the push-gate cutover, which waits on S10 and may take longer; the report states whether the cutover had happened by the window's end. The summary is posted to the loopctl channel and filed to the KB as a finding by the session that runs it.
non_goals: A dashboard or MCP tool for these numbers: the report is a file; no endpoint is added.
Agent-hours of CI wait and worktree ready time (chg S9's other metrics, design.md:425): not in #985's Done-when.
Fixing a metric that misses its target: a new story named in the report.

failure_modes.partition: AC-53.7.7: a fetch that failed leaves an input missing, and the task refuses rather than reporting on part of the week.
failure_modes.state: AC-53.7.6: the inputs and the two artifacts are files; the task keeps nothing else.
failure_modes.retry: AC-53.7.6: the task is a pure function of its input directory and window, so a re-run writes identical artifacts.
failure_modes.slow: AC-53.7.8: every gh and flyctl call in flow-inputs.sh runs under timeout 60, so a slow API fails the fetch instead of hanging it.
failure_modes.reach: n/a: a session runs the script and the task on its own machine; nothing is dispatched or addressed.

definition_of_done: docs/measurements/chg_flow_<end-date>.json and .md exist for the seven days after the fast commit hook merged, and the markdown shows PR CI median, catch-up merges without a conflict, deploys not from verified/master, master red time and revert count, each beside its target.
#985 is closed with that table when the first three targets are met, or kept open with each missed metric and its cause named.
defaults: Window: seven days from the fast commit hook's merge (owner may change).
Targets: PR CI median under 300 s; zero catch-up merges without a conflict; zero deploys not from verified/master; red time and revert count reported, no target.
PR CI = the CI workflow push run at the PR's head sha (not the slowest required check).
